question: Lynch (2002h) Table 3 gives sample reflexes of the POc labials and labiovelars in eleven languages. Which are entered?
chosen_reading: None for now. Mota, the one column not yet covered, cannot be restated against PNCV, whose inventory in the data has no labials (PNCV has neither consonant rows nor inherit): Mota *bʷ ᵏpʷ, *b p, *pʷ v (w), *p p (fortis) and v (w) (lenis), *mʷ mʷ, *m m wait for PNCV's consonants (Clark 2009). Anejom̃, Nemi and Pohnpeian already have these correspondences from Lynch (2001), Haudricourt & Ozanne-Rivierre (1982) and Bender et al. (2003); Tongan is left out because the data has no PPn rows for the labiovelars to restate it against; Loniu, Manam, Dobu, Lau and Wayan are not in the data.
alternatives: Add Lynch's crossover reflexes (Nemi ᵐbʷ for *bʷ, mʷ for *mʷ; Pohnpeian pʷ for *b) as sporadic rows; add a Proto-Eastern Oceanic node with fortis *p and lenis *v.
